questions.question: A train takes 45 minutes to cover a certain distance at a speed of 80 km/h. If the speed is increased by 125%, then how long will it take the train to cover 8/5 of the same distance ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A train takes 45 minutes to cover a certain distance at a speed of 80 km/h

His speed is increased by 125%

Then how long will it take the train to cover 8/5 of the same distance 

**Formula used:**

velocity= distance/time

**Calculation:**

Distance = velocity × time

Distance = 80 × (45 / 60)

⇒ 60 km

Speed is increased by 125%

⇒ 80 + 80 × (125/100)

⇒ 180 km/hour

The train to cover 8/5 of the same distance 

Distance = 60 × (8/5)

⇒ 96 km

So time is taken by train,

Time = distance/speed

⇒ (96/180) = 8 / 15 hr 

⇒ (8/15) hr = (8 / 15) × 60 = 32 minutes

⇒ 32 minutes

**Therefore, covered the distance by train in 32 minutes**

questions.question: A and B can do a work in 15 days and 10 days respectively. They begin the work together but B leaves after two days. Now A completes the remaining work. The total number of days needed for the completion of the work is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A can-do work in 15 days

B can do work in 10 days 

**Concept used**:

A can do a work in n days 

So, A's one day work = 1/n

**Calculation: **

A can-do a work in 15 days 

⇒ A's one-day work = 1/15

B can do a work in 10 days

⇒ B's one day work = 1/10

A and B's one day work = 1/15 + 1/10

⇒ 5/30 = 1/6

Two days work of A and B will be 2/6 = 1/3

Remaining work after B left = 1- 1/3 = 2/3

A will finished remaining work in = (2/3) × 15 = 10 days

**∴ Total number of days to complete work is 10 + 2 = 12 days ** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

LCM of 15 and 10 is 30 

A = 15 × 2 = 30

B = 10 × 3 = 30

Total work = 30 unit

B does 3 unit work in one day

A does 2 unit work in one day

⇒ (A + B)'s one day's work is (3 + 2) unit = 5 unit

⇒ (A + B)'s two days' work is (5 × 2) unit = 10 unit

⇒ Remaining work = 30 - 10 = 20 unit 

A will complete remaining work in, 20/2 = 10 days 

Total number of days = (10 + 2) days = 12 days

∴ Total number of days to complete work is 12 days

cosecθ = H/P, sinθ = P/H, cosθ = B/P

questions.question: If A is an acute angle and cot A + cosec A = 3, then the value of cos A is equal to:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__
If **cosec A + cot A = x**, then **cosec A − cot A = 1/x**.

Given: **cosec A + cot A = 3** ⇒ **cosec A − cot A = 1/3**.

Adding both: **2 cosec A = 3 + 1/3 = 10/3** ⇒ **cosec A = 5/3**.

Since **sin A = 3/5**, using **Pythagorean triplet (3, 4, 5)**, the base is **4**.

**cos A = Base/Hypotenuse = 4/5**.

**∴ The correct answer is 4/5.**

**__Alternate Method__**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c94d66c87713c3ee0cf1cfbc686751b09e57b62f5c90ca46f7a8f790e6966370.png] 
**Given:** **cot A + cosec A = 3**

**Formula Used:** **cosec²A − cot²A = 1**

⇒ (cosec A − cot A)(cosec A + cot A) = 1

⇒ (cosec A − cot A) × 3 = 1

⇒ **cosec A − cot A = 1/3** --- (Equation 1)

⇒ **cosec A + cot A = 3** --- (Equation 2)

⇒ Adding (1) and (2): 2 cosec A = 3 + 1/3 = 10/3

⇒ **cosec A = 5/3**

⇒ Since **sin A = 1/cosec A**, **sin A = 3/5**

⇒ **cos²A = 1 − sin²A**

⇒ cos²A = 1 − (3/5)² = 1 − 9/25 = 16/25

⇒ **cos A = √(16/25) = 4/5**

**∴ The correct answer is 4/5.**

**__Additional Information__**

Trigonometric Identities

Fundamental identities include **sin²A + cos²A = 1**, **1 + tan²A = sec²A**, and **1 + cot²A = cosec²A**.

Pythagorean Triplets

Common triplets like **(3, 4, 5)**, (5, 12, 13), and (8, 15, 17) help in solving right-angled triangle problems quickly without long square root calculations.

Reciprocal Relations

Remember that **cosec A = 1/sin A**, **sec A = 1/cos A**, and **cot A = 1/tan A**.</p
